subtopic: Geometry of Complex Numbers (Argand Geometry & Loci)
title: Arg-loci, equilateral triangles, and modulus extrema

board_content.text: Arcs, triangles, and extremes on a circle

board_content.latex: \arg\frac{z-z_1}{z-z_2}=\alpha\ \text{(fixed)}: \text{ an ARC of a circle through } z_1,z_2

board_content.text: A fixed argument gives an arc, NOT the whole circle.
$\alpha=\tfrac{\pi}{2}$ gives the circle with diameter $z_1z_2$ (minus endpoints).
Nearest and farthest points lie along the line through $O$ and $z_0$.

segments_english.text: A few more standard loci and conditions round out the toolkit. First, the argument locus.
If the argument of z minus z one over z minus z two is held at a fixed value alpha, the locus is an arc of a circle passing through z one and z two.
Emphasize the word arc. A fixed argument does not give the whole circle, only the arc on which the segment subtends that constant angle. Calling it the full circle is a classic error.
The special case alpha equals pi over two is the familiar one: it gives the circle with the segment z one to z two as diameter, excluding the two endpoints.
For four points, the concyclic condition: z one, z two, z three, z four lie on a circle, or a line, exactly when their cross-ratio is real.
The equilateral-triangle condition is a clean symmetric identity: z one squared plus z two squared plus z three squared equals z one z two plus z two z three plus z three z one.
Finally, modulus extrema on a circle. If z lies on the circle of centre z zero and radius r, then the modulus of z is squeezed between the size of modulus z zero minus r, and modulus z zero plus r.
Geometrically, the nearest and farthest points from the origin lie along the straight line through O and the centre z zero. Don't guess the extremes — walk that line.

segments_hinglish.text: Kuch aur standard loci aur conditions toolkit ko poora karte hain. Pehle, argument locus.
Agar z minus z one over z minus z two ka argument ek fixed value alpha par rakha jaaye, to locus hai z one aur z two se guzarti ek circle ka arc.
Shabd arc par zor do. Fixed argument poora circle nahi deta, sirf wo arc jahan segment wo constant angle subtend karta hai. Ise full circle kehna ek classic error hai.
Special case alpha barabar pi over two familiar hai: ye wo circle deta hai jiska diameter segment z one se z two hai, do endpoints ko chhodkar.
Chaar points ke liye, concyclic condition: z one, z two, z three, z four ek circle par, ya ek line par, tabhi hain jab unka cross-ratio real ho.
Equilateral-triangle condition ek clean symmetric identity hai: z one squared plus z two squared plus z three squared barabar z one z two plus z two z three plus z three z one.
Aakhir mein, circle par modulus extrema. Agar z centre z zero aur radius r ke circle par ho, to z ka modulus dab jaata hai size of modulus z zero minus r, aur modulus z zero plus r ke beech.
Geometrically, origin se nearest aur farthest points O aur centre z zero se jaati straight line par hote hain. Extremes guess mat karo — us line par chalo.
